Through: Mr. Hitesh Vali, A
 with Mr. Deepanka
 with Si Ankur, Ps
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal

This petition has been filed for quashing of Fir No. 678/2020 under Sections
498A/506/323/341/34 Ipc Ps Sultan Puri.

2.  Respondent No.2 appears through VC and duly identified by the IO and states that aside from what is recorded in the settlement, an RC of a vehicle had to be transferred back to the respondent No.2 as well as Rs.11,000/- had to be given by which her counsel is aware of.
However, her counsel is not available today.
3. Accordingly, list on 22nd August, 2024, when the counsel for respondent No.2 as well as respondent No.2 will be present in Court.
4. Petitioner No.1 will also be present in Court along with his counsel on the next date of hearing.
5. Petitioner Nos.2-7 were exempted by order dated 22nd April, 2024.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/08/2024 at 04:02:10 6.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J AUGUST 13, 2024/MK
This is a digitally signed order.
